Additionally, drug reaction with eosinophilia and systemic symptoms (DRESS) and acute generalized exanthematous pustulosis (AGEP) have been reported with amoxicillin. CDAD should be considered in all patients presenting with diarrhea after antibacterial use. A thorough medical history is necessary, as CDAD can occur over two months after administration.
